title: Throw Glove power-up — pick up + throw your bomb over walls
notes: Promotes GDP-2026-05-26-004 (could-priority, KABOOM-CREW-MVP-2). Throw Glove extends the S100 Kick concept with longer-range bomb relocation. When a bomber holds the glove they can PICK UP their own placed bomb (input: T key while standing on bomb cell) and CARRY it (fuse paused; bomb mounts visually on torso.back). A second press of T THROWS the bomb 3 cells in the bomber's facing direction in an arc over any obstacles in between; lands grid-snapped + resumes fuse.

Scope simplification vs the GDP spec: GDP asks for long-press Space to dual-use the place-bomb key. Long-press detection is risky to wire into the existing input system; we use a dedicated T key instead so the pickup/throw signal is unambiguous. README + HUD document the key.

Out of scope this sprint (per the original GDP): audio events (existing 'bomb-place' on landing is enough); bot AI integration (bots collect the pickup but don't use it strategically); throw distance scaling by stacking; catching thrown bombs mid-flight; throwing opponents' bombs; multiplayer server parity (deferred alongside GDP-2026-05-27-002 Pierce server parity to a connected-mode sprint).

stories.title: Schema: Pickup.kind += 'throw-glove'; BomberStats.canThrow; Bomb.carriedBy + airborne
stories.summary: examples/kaboom-crew/schemas/scene-extensions.schema.json — Pickup.kind enum gains 'throw-glove'. BomberStats gains optional `canThrow: boolean` (default false). Bomb gains optional `carriedBy: string` (entity id; fuse pauses while set) + `airborne: boolean` (true during the 0.45s arc; fuse stays paused). Two new transient components: pickupBombRequestComponent + throwBombRequestComponent.

stories.title: Player input wires T key → PickupBombRequest or ThrowBombRequest
stories.summary: examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/player-input-system.ts — bind `KeyT` such that: (a) bomber has canThrow + is on their own bomb cell + not already carrying → write PickupBombRequest with bomberEntityId + bombEntityId; (b) bomber has canThrow + is carrying a bomb (BomberStats.carryingBombId set) → write ThrowBombRequest with bomberEntityId. BomberStats also gains `carryingBombId: string` so the input system can branch without reading the Bomb component.
verification: acceptance: player-input-system binds KeyT edge-triggered → PickupBombRequest{bombId} when stats.canThrow + standing on own bomb, ThrowBombRequest{} when stats.canThrow + carryingBombId set. findOwnBombAt helper scans bomb query for the owner+cell match.

stories.title: bomb-pickup-system consumes PickupBombRequest; bomb-fuse pauses carried bombs
stories.summary: examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/bomb-pickup-system.ts (NEW) — fixedUpdate consumes PickupBombRequest transients. For each request: validate (bomb still exists, bomber on bomb cell, bomb.ownerId == bomberId, bomb not airborne); on success, set Bomb.carriedBy = bomberId + decrement the bomber's activeBombs counter (so they can place a new bomb while carrying); store the bombId in BomberStats.carryingBombId; remove GridOccupant on the bomb so the cell unblocks. examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/bomb-fuse-system.ts: skip fuse decrement when `bomb.carriedBy` is set.
verification: acceptance: examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/bomb-pickup-system.ts (NEW) consumes PickupBombRequest. Sets Bomb.carriedBy + BomberStats.carryingBombId + decrements activeBombs + removes GridOccupant. bomb-fuse-system now skips bombs with carriedBy or airborne flag (S144 fuse-pause).

stories.title: bomb-throw-system consumes ThrowBombRequest; computes landing + spawns arc tween
stories.summary: examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/bomb-throw-system.ts (NEW) — fixedUpdate consumes ThrowBombRequest. Reads bomber's facing direction from S108 BomberFaces (or GridMover.queuedDirection / lastDirection as fallback). Computes landing cell = bomberCell + facing × 3; on invalid (out of bounds, hard-block, occupied by another bomber) backs off to ×2, ×1, then bomber's own cell. Spawns the bomb back into the world at the landing cell with Bomb.airborne=true and a Tween on Transform.position (parabolic arc, 0.45s duration). On tween-end signal (via existing Tween onComplete or a Bomb.airborne + lifetime check): clear airborne, restore GridOccupant, clear BomberStats.carryingBombId, resume fuse decrement.
verification: acceptance: examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/bomb-throw-system.ts (NEW) consumes ThrowBombRequest, resolves facing via queuedDirection then yaw-cardinal, picks landing cell ×3→×2→×1→bomber-cell, sets Bomb.airborne+airborneRemaining, fires position Tween 0.45s easeOutQuad. Per-tick airborne timer countdown lands the bomb when ≤ 0: clears airborne, restores GridOccupant. Registered before bomb-fuse-system in bootstrap.

stories.title: Unit tests covering pickup → carry → throw → land chain
stories.summary: Cover: (1) pickup-collect sets canThrow; (2) PickupBombRequest valid → carriedBy set + activeBombs decremented + carryingBombId stored; (3) PickupBombRequest invalid (wrong bomb owner / not on bomb cell) → silent NO-OP; (4) bomb-fuse skips carried bombs (no fuse decrement); (5) ThrowBombRequest lands the bomb at +3 cells in facing dir; (6) hard-block at +3 → fallback to +2; (7) hard-block at +1 → fallback to bomber cell (last-resort); (8) airborne flag flips off after the tween completes (or after a lifetime fixedUpdate threshold).
verification: acceptance: examples/kaboom-crew/tests/unit/throw-glove.test.ts adds 13 tests — resolveFacingDirection helper (3), bomb-pickup-system happy + invalid paths (4), bomb-fuse pause carried + airborne (2), bomb-throw lands at +3/+2/bomber-cell + airborne timer lands the bomb (4). 1567/1567 tests pass.
